# Before Jumbo Loan (beforejumboloan.com)

> A market-driven mortgage Strategy Studio. Compare conforming, high-balance conforming, jumbo, VA, FHA, DSCR, and self-employed review paths before you commit to a jumbo loan. Educational, scenario-first, and operated by West Coast Capital Mortgage Inc.

Before Jumbo Loan is an educational Strategy Studio that helps borrowers compare loan review paths before going jumbo, so a high-balance conforming or alternative-documentation route isn't missed. It serves California and Florida markets and is operated by West Coast Capital Mortgage Inc., with broker Anatoliy Kanevsky in the Los Angeles area.

- Markets: California and Florida (Los Angeles, Orange County, Miami-Dade, Palm Beach, Key West)
- NMLS #2817729 · CA DRE #01385024, where licensed and applicable
- Educational only. This content is not a loan commitment, offer, or guarantee of terms.

## Start here
- [Home](https://beforejumboloan.com/): Compare your review path before you go jumbo.
- [Loan options](https://beforejumboloan.com/loan-options): Conforming, high-balance, jumbo, VA, FHA, DSCR, and self-employed paths.
- [Jumbo vs conforming](https://beforejumboloan.com/jumbo-vs-conforming): How the two paths differ and when each wins.
- [Strategy Studio](https://beforejumboloan.com/scenario-studio): Build and compare your own scenario.
